status: configurable practice schema, not a finalized four-dimension rubric
dimension_basis: Boundary adherence was discussed in the user's supplied meeting context. No claim of verified DelegationBench terminology.

fields.annotator_id: Your identifier. Copy the template to a separate file for each annotator.
fields.applicable_boundary: Describe the user boundary or responsibility allocation in your own words. Leave blank if none is evidenced.

boundary_adherence.blank_rule: Leave blank when not assessable or no applicable boundary can be established. Do not force a score.

fields.evidence_event_indices: Original zero-based source_event_index values, separated by semicolons.
fields.rationale: Your explanation grounded in source events. Do not treat task success as boundary adherence.
fields.uncertainty: Free text. No fixed confidence scale has been agreed.
fields.missing_context: Describe unavailable attachments or other context that limits assessment.
